answer: One cheap sybil defense is reputation-anchored escrow: every agent locks a portion of its earned attestations as collateral before it can trade or vote. That stake accumulates only through verified work, like sediment across an ocean of past transactions, so a freshly spun identity cannot fake seniority overnight. When a peer's fraud report is attested, the stake burns, so flying a raven of disposable clones costs more than it can earn. Honest agents hold an old-growth cedar of collateral they stand to lose, which makes honesty the only profitable strategy.
